stories.title: Contract/toolchain baseline
stories.implementation: Pin the Rust and architecture-check Python toolchains with lockfiles; add one reproducible local/CI check command; build a minimal litecoworkd CLI supporting help/version only. Defer Node/TypeScript/pnpm pins to E02-S01; do not start a listener, open storage, or launch an agent.
stories.acceptance: A clean checkout runs scripts/check.sh with exact pinned versions, Rust format/lint/test/build, Python fixture tests, and both contract validators. CLI help/version succeed and unsupported options fail. No operational Runtime behavior is claimed.
stories.negative_cases: Missing or mismatched pinned toolchain, malformed JSON schema fixture, unsupported CLI option.
stories.demo: Run scripts/check.sh in a clean checkout, then run cargo run --locked -p litecoworkd -- --help and cargo run --locked -p litecoworkd -- --version on the reference development OS.

stories.title: Transactional persistence
stories.implementation: Build the first Workspace persistence vertical slice: StateStore/EventStore/BlobStore ports, WorkspaceService create and policy-update commands, bounded rusqlite writer, versioned schema migration/fingerprint, encrypted content-addressed filesystem blobs through an injected WorkspaceBlobKeyProvider, atomic aggregate/event/origin-sequence commit, restart and projection replay. The desktop OS key-provider implementation exists; platform qualification, rotation/recovery tests, and cryptographic review remain open. SQLite v3 source adds/backfills RuntimeWorkspaceBinding and gates Attempt admission; daemon binding persistence/query and migration qualification are still open. Four v1 composite Runtime/Workspace foreign keys continue to limit a Runtime row to one Workspace. rusqlite is provisional pending SP02 comparison.
stories.acceptance: On-disk SQLite and filesystem adapters commit Workspace state/event/sequence atomically; one of two stale competing writes wins; restart replay equals the current projection; migration/configuration drift, unsupported schema, missing keys and blob authentication fail closed. Owner acceptance remains pending and E01-S01 is still IN_REVIEW.
stories.negative_cases: Concurrent stale writes; injected rollback after aggregate, sequence and event writes; busy timeout; interrupted migration/retry; schema fingerprint drift; corrupt ciphertext; wrong Workspace or purpose; broad blob directory permissions; failed blob commit. Actual database/filesystem disk-full and production key-provider cases remain untested.
stories.demo: Run cargo test --locked -p storage-sqlite workspace_create_update_restart_and_projection_replay_match -- --nocapture, then scripts/check.sh. Confirm the printed synthetic Workspace summary, event sequence and replay equality; inspect limitations in implementation/reviews/E01-S02.md.

stories.title: Independent Runtime lifecycle
stories.implementation: Partial: litecoworkd run/status acquires a cross-process single-instance file lock, persists local bootstrap Runtime/incarnation identity and lifecycle state atomically, opens LocalWorkspaceStorage, serves authenticated local Operator routes, reports DEGRADED until Task recovery/execution exists, and closes storage on shutdown. If Operator initialization fails after incarnation registration, the catalog is already DEGRADED; the specific OPERATOR_API_START_FAILED blocker is stored in private local status and the daemon exits nonzero to release the lock for bounded supervisor/manual retry. Remaining: full domain recovery, authenticated start/stop controls, native service-manager qualification, sleep/wake, dependency-aware drain preview, and process identity reconciliation. Current source has not been built or tested.
stories.acceptance: Closing Operator leaves daemon running; reboot changes incarnation; stale process cannot own a lease; workers lazy-start.
stories.negative_cases: Duplicate startup, SIGKILL/restart, corrupted/symlinked state, lock-file symlink/broad permissions, sleep during write, invalid state directory permissions, storage/key-store recovery failure, and shutdown signal during drain.
stories.demo: Start the daemon twice against one state directory, inspect DEGRADED status, stop gracefully, restart and inspect incarnation/recovery state. This demonstrates bootstrap lifecycle only; Task recovery and authenticated control remain pending.

stories.title: Authenticated Operator boundary
stories.implementation: Partial development bootstrap: litecoworkd serves authenticated loopback GET Workspace list/read and POST Workspace create using a per-incarnation high-entropy bearer credential; validates exact Host, rejects browser Origin, filters by local owner, and requires matching X-Workspace-ID for Workspace read. Workspace create supports contract-approved initial replication policies (SELECTED_FOLDERS waits until roots exist) and stores an idempotency receipt atomically with aggregate/event commit. Tauri native code reads a private descriptor and lists/creates Workspaces without exposing the credential to frontend JS. This does not authenticate the OS peer and is not production-qualified. The production IPC contract is docs/LOCAL-OPERATOR-IPC.md. A shared framing primitive exists but is not integrated; it does not enforce connection count or I/O deadlines. Remaining: Runtime-to-OS-principal binding, authenticated listener with Unix peer checks and per-logon Windows pipe DACL, Tauri IPC client migration with no HTTP fallback, remaining domain routes, pagination, event replay/stream, generated client, lifecycle controls and OS qualification. Current edits are unbuilt and untested.
stories.acceptance: Replay returns same command result; another origin/unauthenticated process denied; reconnect fills missed events before live updates.
stories.negative_cases: Malformed ID, cross-Workspace request, reused RequestId with changed payload, slow stream.
stories.demo: Use desktop client and adversarial HTTP client against same daemon.

stories.title: Desktop shell/onboarding
stories.implementation: Partial: Tauri 2 + React shell has Home/Work/Library/Needs You/Settings, honest empty states, and native commands to start litecoworkd, display persisted/live-lock status, and list/create Workspaces through authenticated Operator routes. The Home composer saves standalone Task envelopes through authenticated local IPC. It pins exact Library Resource revisions when explicitly selected; Task detail shows the actual READY state and says no accepted plan is currently saved without inferring the Task has never started. It does not start planning or execution. Node.js 24.21.0 is pinned in .node-version/package.json engines; pnpm 12.10.1 is pinned in package.json; pnpm-workspace.yaml sets nodeVersion 24.21.0 and engineStrict true; pnpm-lock.yaml was generated with --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts and was not regenerated after adding engine validation config. npm is unsupported. Strict rejection and frozen install/build remain unverified. Other remaining work: packaged signed daemon sidecar, tray/background lifecycle, reconnect acceptance and product Task execution. Current edits are unbuilt and untested.
stories.acceptance: Fresh install creates local Workspace; no fake worker card; daemon offline is explicit; native shell survives reconnect.
stories.negative_cases: Webview missing, daemon unavailable, repeated submit, resize/200% zoom; wrong Node major/too-old patch, pnpm rejects an incompatible required dependency engine, mismatched pnpm, changed manifest against frozen lockfile must fail without silently resolving. npm is unsupported.
stories.demo: Install on reference OS, create Workspace and close/reopen Operator.

stories.title: Workspace policy and instructions
stories.implementation: Implement Workspace revise/archive, replication policy, roots, versioned instructions and optimistic concurrency. Basic local create is currently in E01-S04. Unverified slices: authenticated Workspace replication-policy update has expected-version checks, idempotent transaction receipts, and a desktop Settings selector; immutable instruction revisions use pinned same-Workspace UTF-8 text Resources, transactional local projection/event/receipt writes, opaque paginated history, and a desktop editor/history view. Cloud transfer is not implemented; SELECTED_FOLDERS awaits WorkspaceRoot support; Tasks do not yet pin instructions.
stories.acceptance: Tasks pin instructions; archive cannot strand active authority; local-only is default; stale editor gets conflict with current revision available for comparison; instruction revision/history is owner- and Workspace-scoped; exact retries are idempotent; local policy UI does not imply cloud transfer.
stories.negative_cases: Root escapes; overlapping roots; offline policy edit; archive with active Task; stale If-Match; same RequestId with changed policy or instruction; selected-folder policy without validated roots; lost response followed by exact retry; wrong Workspace header/path; foreign or unpinned ResourceRef; non-UTF-8, non-text, >64 KiB, or digest-mismatched instruction content; duplicate/nonexistent/wrong-parent instruction revisions; pagination cursor replay or cross-Workspace cursor; Workspace switch during editor/history reads; Resource import succeeds but instruction revision commit fails
stories.demo: Create two Workspaces and prove isolated instructions and search.

stories.title: Resource intake and factual index
stories.implementation: Unverified desktop/local slices: multi-file/folder intake and resumable upload sessions up to 100 MiB/file using encrypted 4 MiB chunks, 24-hour expiry, durable progress, reselected-file hash checks, zero-byte commit, atomic Resource/revision/location/event/session-commit, and encrypted orphan cleanup with durable reservations/GC fences. Workspace-scoped Resource catalog is keyset paginated. Authenticated exact-revision reads and Tauri text preview are bounded to 1 MiB. A ContextDocument editor supports immutable Resource revision upload/history and explicit ACTIVE/REVOKED transitions; exact Resource revisions can be pinned to saved Task inputs without reading content or granting agent access. The Library supports metadata filters, filter-only metadata browse, bounded ON_DEMAND_CONTENT search, and INDEXED_CONTENT search. The encrypted v7 lexical projection stores encrypted text snapshots and Workspace/purpose-scoped HMAC tokens, matches deterministic Unicode terms with AND, returns bounded snippets with revision provenance, and fails closed if the key is unavailable. Explicit rebuild of the exact current managed Resource revision is available through authenticated Operator/Tauri/UI routes; it pins revision/digest and commits projection plus idempotency receipt after revalidation. A failed eligible-text rebuild exposes a session-only retry pinned to the same Workspace/Resource/revision/digest and reuses its RequestId; it is not durable indexing health or durable failure/retry state. Query tokens over 128 normalized Unicode characters are rejected rather than silently dropped from AND semantics. Persistent WorkspaceRoots have create/list/pause/resume/revoke source paths, private authenticated folder selection, and startup identity revalidation for supported Linux/macOS; they are not OS-qualified and have no watcher. ZIPs and rich documents remain opaque/unparsed. Physical index/blob purge and cleanup integration, durable indexing failure state/retry, background migration/reindex, binary preview, watcher-based freshness/invalidation, bounded supervised ZIP inspection/extraction with Core-owned Resource publication, PDF/Office parsing/OCR, embeddings, semantic RAG, and local-model retrieval remain unimplemented or unqualified. Root handling still needs complete cross-platform identity and Desktop Runtime catalog qualification; raw selected paths remain outside WebView/public Operator data. Multi-file upload can pause client-side between requests while retaining resumable sessions; no server cancellation is sent. All source is unbuilt/unverified and E02-S03 acceptance is open.
stories.acceptance: Cancel/restart upload resumes verified chunks; rename preserves correct identity; search metadata does not silently attach content; supported text indexes are encrypted, pinned to the exact current revision and Workspace, return bounded provenance-backed snippets, survive daemon restart, and fail closed when a required key is unavailable.
stories.negative_cases: Symlink/TOCTOU, duplicate digest, deleted root, watcher overflow, unsupported encoding, crash between upload blob reservation/blob write/receipt, shared digest retained while referenced, concurrent collector/reservation fencing, restart with DELETING fence, missing-object idempotency, deletion-provider failure retry, ZIP/PDF/Office and oversized inputs never indexed, malformed UTF-8/control-heavy text skipped, stale revision excluded, cross-Workspace token mismatch, lost retained key, rotation with old and active key versions, snapshot tampering, context revocation while searching, query term/byte bounds, and failed v7 migration rollback/retry.
stories.demo: Import a project folder, rename/edit files, search and inspect exact revisions.

stories.title: Needs You and truthful UI state
stories.implementation: Partial unverified source: the desktop Needs You page queries the existing authenticated Task list independently for WAITING_USER, NEEDS_USER, and BLOCKED; validates status matches, merges/deduplicates, orders by persisted updated_at, and pages each status cursor separately. Same-Workspace refresh failures retain prior rows with an unavailable notice; Workspace changes clear old data and fence late results. Selecting a row opens Work/Task detail for a fresh read without mutating the Task. The page explicitly says Approval/UserRequest inbox actions and blocker resolution are not connected. The normative GET /v1/needs-you aggregate route remains unimplemented; no actual inbox aggregation or owner action handling has been added.
stories.acceptance: Resolving source removes one item; activity and verified Evidence labels differ; no token heartbeat implies completion.
stories.negative_cases: Wrong-status Task returned for filter, duplicate IDs across pages, one status query fails, same-Workspace stale refresh, Workspace switch with late response, stale status before Task detail, unavailable initial load not shown as empty, duplicate event, already-resolved item, unauthorized notification click, reduced motion.
stories.demo: Open persisted WAITING_USER, NEEDS_USER, and BLOCKED Tasks from Needs You; verify status, refresh detail, then confirm opening did not change Task state. Full blocker/Approval/UserRequest resolution remains a later acceptance gate.

OpenCode inventory accepts its documented bare semver output but has no profile probe; current contract authorizes only Codex probing. Task AgentSession admission/readiness, model entitlement/inference, process-tree containment and provider qualification remain incomplete.

stories.negative_cases: Missing binary, expired auth, config drift, unavailable model, plugin conflict.
stories.demo: Compare selected native agent with LiteCowork launched session using same config.

stories.negative_cases: Turn retry/replay, crash after output before settlement, oversized attachment.
stories.demo: Ask a quick question, interrupt, restart and inspect visible conversation.

stories.title: Planning and atomic plan acceptance
stories.implementation: Source now includes standalone Task creation, durable planner reservation/activation, initial PlanRevision/Step acceptance in one SQLite transaction, idempotent replay, complete Task/Step event-state blobs, plan/Step GET reads, and a bounded saved-Task objective revision path. The revision path is limited to READY/no-Plan/no-live-planner Tasks, uses If-Match + exact parent + idempotency key, and preserves omitted fields. The Tauri Task detail exposes objective editing, an exact authenticated read-only TaskSpec history disclosure, and reloads committed state. History checks Task/Workspace identity, ordered positive revisions, parent pins, author identity, and timestamps; compares the history head with the loaded Task revision; labels a newer saved head without calling the older Task detail current; offers explicit Task reload for stale/incomplete heads only when no objective draft or unresolved revision request is open; and has no restore action. Initial plans require a current active TASK_PLANNING session; replan admission remains unavailable until Attempt/lease authority exists. The Home composer saves standalone Tasks with exact pinned Resource revisions, server-resolved Coworker revision/failover provenance, and a same-window retry envelope that retains the original RequestId and lead/Coworker snapshot; changed drafts are blocked until the owner checks Work and explicitly clears the unresolved retry. Tauri validates returned Task/TaskSpec identity, objective, and ordered Resource refs, and the UI independently checks the returned objective and inputs before clearing the draft. The retry envelope is not persisted across application restart. The composer does not admit planning or execution. The API plan POST remains unwired because authenticated Operator requests do not yet carry trusted producer-scoped session authority; no native agent invokes the plan service. Task detail has a read-only planning-readiness diagnostic through the authenticated GET route; it shows sanitized blockers and always reports planning dispatch unavailable. It creates no execution state and remains source-only/unverified. See F100 and F106. Source is unbuilt/untested and this story does not meet acceptance.
stories.acceptance: No Attempt before accepted Step; stale plans refused; criteria and resources pinned; changed intent creates revision.
stories.negative_cases: Concurrent acceptance, invalid DAG, missing capability, stale TaskSpec, plan crash; objective editor rejects stale version/parent, active planner, accepted Plan, non-READY/terminal Task, invalid or unchanged objective, and changed-payload reuse of an idempotency key; lost response retry returns the original revision; objective-only edit preserves all other spec fields and starts no planning/execution record.
stories.demo: Save a standalone Task, revise its objective before planning, reload and inspect the immutable spec revision/event; then confirm stale/planned Task conflicts and no planner/session/Attempt is started. Separately request repo review and inspect plan/Steps when the full producer path is available.

stories.title: DelegationProfile lifecycle and UI

The desktop profile card now shows allowlisted Codex probe stages and makes untested inference/session start and unproven writer quiescence explicit; these diagnostics are not execution readiness. Code/system/owner acceptance, lockfile resolution, and verification remain open.

stories.title: Task-scoped local Environment isolation
stories.implementation: In progress, preparation plus Linux lower-level isolation source: `local-environment-staging` materializes caller-resolved exact-pinned Resource bytes into a Unix mode-restricted root with read-only inputs and separate outputs; `linux-process-scope` now composes its cgroup runner with Bubblewrap mount/user/PID/network/IPC/UTS namespaces, an empty tmpfs root, exact staged input/output mounts, and explicit read-only runtime binds. Live Bubblewrap checks on one Ubuntu 24.04.4 host proved staged input read-only, output writable, host `/home` absent, and host-loopback network unreachable. The combined systemd+cgroup path could not be run on the current host (`systemctl --user` degraded; cgroup path `/non-systemd`). This is not an EnvironmentProvider and is not connected to Task admission or Resource resolution; no Runtime-local attestation/restart identity, aggregate output quota, authenticated egress broker, wall-deadline controller, native capability mediation, or Trust/Effect/lease recovery exists. Runtime network is fully denied, so remote-model agents cannot operate in this sandbox. Remaining: integrate exact ResourceStore staging, production output limits and approved egress, provider binding/attestation and restart recovery, combine cgroup/Bubblewrap system qualification on supported Linux, implement cancellation/deadline handling, and integrate Trust, Effects and leases before any dispatch. Keep Agent dispatch disabled. A local directory or Git worktree alone is not containment. Desktop knowledge-work target includes provider-enforced file-root modes read-only, read/write, and read/write/no-delete where supported. This is an Environment boundary, not prompt text; unsupported providers must say so.
stories.acceptance: A real child process can read only exact authorized staged inputs, write only declared output roots, cannot access forbidden home/workspace paths or unapproved network, and cannot leave descendant writers after quiescence is reported. Missing/unknown OS guarantees fail closed. Provider preparation itself creates no Attempt, AgentSession, or lease.
stories.negative_cases: Foreign/missing/stale/digest-mismatched Resource pins; path traversal; symlink escape; source mutation during staging; permission denial; network escape; surviving child writer; lost create response; stale Runtime incarnation; provider timeout; unsupported OS mechanism; concurrent cleanup/use; unknown quiescence. Symlink escape from authorized root; delete through read/write-no-delete; provider claims a mode it cannot enforce; credential leakage into guest/process.
stories.demo: Import a small real project Resource, prepare a local Environment, verify exact visible inputs and separate output location, attempt harmless out-of-scope access, restart litecoworkd, revalidate identity, and verify cleanup after positive quiescence.

stories.title: Coworker identity and Home
stories.implementation: Implemented source remains partial and unverified: revisioned Coworker/default lead/interaction defaults/primary selection, presence projection, enabled worker-profile assignment, and Coworker/Goal/Automation settings are mounted. Home now shows the selected Coworker, paginates the active roster, allows explicit Workspace defaults, pins the exact Coworker ID/version into Task creation, and rejects stale/archived/unavailable selections without silently falling back; retry matching includes the selection. Home also offers optional, explicit neutral Assistant creation and a separate versioned primary selection, preserving drafts and unchanged retry IDs; no settings are created implicitly. Remaining: ordinary Conversation turns, the full Home hierarchy, lead discovery/full guided onboarding and worker setup, navigation/restart command recovery, and final presentation behavior. No source here establishes agent Task execution. Complete only after E05/E06 dependencies and the full owner scenario pass. UI source is unbuilt and unverified. Accepted target adjustment (2026-10-10): the old neutral primary-Coworker Home is transitional, not the final first-run. Required target is optional Coworker and regular session-first chat, with Quick Create name/purpose, optional Customize/Connections and last-active Coworker-owned Conversation. The supporting schema/Operator routes and actual native chat must be implemented; UI copy and collapsible customization alone do not qualify completion. Read docs/COWORKERS-TARGET.md, docs/COWORKER-FLOWS.md and implementation/UI.md.
stories.acceptance: Ordinary Workspace chat is available without Coworkers once native Conversation admission qualifies. Selecting an optional Coworker opens its most recent same-Workspace chat; Quick Create needs name and purpose, while Customize stages can be skipped. Creation preserves input through stale/ambiguous receipts; no implicit monitored work, connections or worker grants. Pause fences new proactive admissions, not in-flight Tasks; archive checks current dependencies and preserves linked history. Existing saved Task origin and Workspace primary preference remain version-pinned; owner verifies chat, navigation and Workbench semantics before story completion.
stories.negative_cases: No Coworkers; no eligible chief; failed agent sign-in; duplicate Quick Create receipt; stale Coworker/Conversation owner; wrong Workspace; rapidly switching Coworkers while history loads; dirty composer/Workbench during navigation; suspended or archived Coworker; missing Conversation ownership route; thousands of configured connectors with lazy discovery; unchanged standalone Task identity; limited OS background availability.
stories.demo: Owner creates an ordinary new conversation without naming a Coworker; creates Research Assistant with just name and purpose; adds a second chat and returns to most recently active chat; optionally adds a connector and external worker, reviews a standing responsibility before enable, and confirms Task/Artifact provenance survives later identity changes. Distinguish current Home Task-save source from the future qualified native Conversation-turn path; do not claim acceptance before real agent send/restart checks.

stories.title: Goals and suggestion producers
stories.implementation: Partial desktop slice: authenticated Workspace-scoped Suggestions list with VISIBLE/SNOOZED/ALL views, bounded filter-bound cursors, and provenance display; authenticated retry-safe dismiss, snooze, unsnooze, and accept commands; atomic acceptance to an ordinary READY Task with pinned inputs, criteria, Goal/Coworker provenance, and Coworker failover policy. Task acceptance returns a bounded CREATED/REPLAYED receipt tied to the original Task request receipt; the desktop preserves the exact Workspace/Suggestion/version/RequestId across route changes in a bounded process-local registry and requires a matching receipt before clearing it. Explicit discard warns the Task may already exist. Other unresolved mutations preserve the exact request and snooze target. Bounded event-backed expiry settlement is wired and refuses to serve the page while due transitions remain. Versioned Workspace kind preferences have virtual unmuted defaults (version 0), authenticated read/update routes, and atomic preference change plus dismissal of current proposed items; the Ideas page exposes mute/unmute controls. Producers/proposal admission, Routine/Automation draft acceptance, and Task planning/execution remain unavailable, so no producer-backed Ideas are generated and acceptance only saves a READY Task. Source is unverified and process restart loses UI retry metadata.
stories.acceptance: Goal never executes; Suggestion accept makes reviewed Task/draft; max one prominent idea; producer cannot self-authorize.
stories.negative_cases: Duplicate proposal, stale source, snoozed/muted suggestion, goal archive race.
stories.demo: Link verified Tasks to goal, surface and accept/dismiss a provenance-backed idea.

stories.title: Editable context lifecycle
stories.implementation: Partial desktop slice: show read-only provenance for existing immutable Workspace instruction revisions (exact source Resource/revision, digest, and parent instruction revisions), explicitly distinct from Task Context used. Additional source-only, unverified API/storage slice mounts owner-scoped Resource detail/history and revision upload. It pins If-Match Resource version plus complete parent heads; commit rechecks pins and content digest/size/media type, atomically appends immutable ResourceRevision/ancestry/head/location/index invalidations and resource.revision.created.v1 with event/snapshot/upload/idempotency state, and supports committed receipt replay. New Library source adds a ContextDocument-only editor: metadata and paged history, replacement local-file selection or small supported text editing, chunked authenticated Tauri upload, and commit pinned to the observed Resource version/current head. Conflict reloads current state and requires the owner to choose content again; no silent rebase. Revocation/deletion are displayed as unavailable, with no actions. This is unbuilt/untested source. ContextDocument metadata editing, merge UI, revoke/delete purge receipts, resumable UI recovery, and affected-session invalidation remain unimplemented. Accepted target adds quiet automatic Coworker-private learning from preauthorized Conversation checkpoints and verified completed Task outcomes, behind qualified agent-backed extraction, policy snapshots, candidate dedupe/conflict/supersession, and Resource-backed versioned metadata. No independent Core semantic model or automatic learning from all connected sources. Current owner-authored ContextDocument UI alone does not satisfy this.
stories.acceptance: Lost edit not overwritten; revoked bytes not reattached; native history cannot be recalled and old session not reused. Additional gate: temporary chats never become memory candidates; automatic private learning requires preauthorized source policy and deterministic privacy/secret validation; scope revocation fences future retrieval, with honest external provider purge receipts. Quiet committed learning is visible in Memory & Knowledge and testable across chief changes.
stories.negative_cases: Two concurrent editors, purge target offline, revocation during context fetch, restore tombstone.
stories.demo: Current partial source demo: inspect exact Workspace instruction Resource/revision, digest, and parent provenance while the UI states this is not Task-used context; open an owner-authored ContextDocument in Library, inspect metadata/paginated history, select revised content or edit a small text Resource, and create a revision pinned to the observed head. Force a concurrent version change and confirm the conflict refreshes history without committing or silently rebasing. This desktop/API/storage source is unbuilt and untested. Full concurrent ContextDocument edit/merge, revoke, purge, and session-invalidation demo remains unimplemented.

stories.title: Live Work surface and activity projection
stories.implementation: Partial, unverified source: the saved Task presentation panel foregrounds the pinned objective/status and committed Artifact outputs, with full activity/source IDs collapsed. It labels stale/unknown snapshot freshness and retains the last selected-Task snapshot with an out-of-date notice after disconnect/refresh failure. The lazy committed-Outputs disclosure now permits retry after a failed read while Runtime-ready; retry aborts superseded reads and remains unavailable while Runtime-offline. Task presentation and Outputs components are keyed by Workspace/Task identity, and the presentation gates saved progress/timestamps/transient errors by selected identity to prevent stale prior-Task state from rendering. Goal details expose read-only navigation from a linked Task to the existing Work detail route. Work list rows display TaskSummary.updatedAt as `Task updated`, not as observed activity; after an initial-page refresh failure they remain available with an explicit stale-list notice and last successful load time. A Load more failure does not incorrectly mark already-loaded rows stale. Task detail validates Workspace/Task identity, rejects mismatched responses, and offers a same-read retry after failure (disabled while Runtime is offline). Authenticated GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}/progress now projects Task/current-plan Step/current Attempt events, latest Evidence time, blockers, and newest resolvable ArtifactVersion from one bounded SQLite snapshot through Operator/Tauri/UI. Terminal current Attempts may provide latest historical activity; only nonterminal current Attempts form active workstreams. Step status is displayed as Step status. Event summaries are allowlisted; provider, CapabilityInvocation, and Environment activity is not integrated. Over-cap sets fail instead of truncating. The current list exposes an exact Task-status selector; semantic Active/Waiting/Scheduled/Done filters, stream/cursor resync, live provider observations, Task execution, and acceptance are not implemented. No tests/builds/validators/provider/OS checks were run.
stories.acceptance: Every lane/output references committed state/version; activity timestamps and verified Evidence remain distinct; stale/missing projections are labeled; advanced IDs stay out of the default flow.
stories.negative_cases: Late/out-of-order projection, cursor expiry/resync, duplicate committed event, worker state reversal, stale Task deep link, Artifact changing while activity is open.
stories.demo: Follow an ordinary Task without Inspector, expand activity, reconnect after projection refresh, then inspect worker/Evidence detail in Inspector.

stories.title: Interaction completeness and accessibility
stories.implementation: Every route empty/loading/offline/error/conflict/permission state; keyboard/search/Quick Entry; motion interruption/reduced motion/contrast/zoom; validate both nontechnical Workbench and technical Inspector paths. Accepted UI target now includes one user-controlled unified right Workbench shell. Brand-new chat keeps it closed; explicit user navigation or restored user pane state may open it. Empty Workbench uses Start with Workspace files, Browser, qualified Computer, conditional advanced Terminal, and actual Recent outputs. Background tool completion never steals focus.
stories.acceptance: All critical paths keyboard usable; live announcements throttled; no fake ETA/cost/progress; state transition only after actual event. Workbench resize/maximize/close and responsive sheet behavior are keyboard accessible; dirty Artifact navigation is protected; switching Workspace/Coworker cannot expose stale/private objects; no fake browser/terminal/computer state.
stories.negative_cases: Long text, 400% zoom, reduced motion, rapid state reversal, deep-link stale auth, reconnect during response stream, revoked context, renderer fallback, keyboard-only version compare/restore., screen-reader status spam during streaming Background result attempts auto-open; stale panel ref after restart; revoked Artifact; no browser provider; terminal unavailable to nontechnical Workspace; dirty edit on Coworker switch; keyboard resize; 400% zoom; panel restore to wrong Workspace.
stories.demo: Owner completes task/approval/takeover by keyboard and reduced motion, then completes one nontechnical document workflow without Inspector and one coding workflow with diff/Evidence detail.

stories.title: Automation and occurrences
stories.implementation: Partial desktop/local slice: authenticated create/revise writes pin an exact Routine revision and explicitly select an exact Coworker revision or null. The local owner ManualTrigger route atomically commits occurrence PENDING v1 -> CLAIMED v2 -> STARTED v3 with an ordinary READY Task, immutable revision pins, events/snapshots and owner RequestId receipt; it requires the current local TRIGGER_HOST binding/incarnation and does not activate recurring triggers or start planning. The desktop editor now offers Manual trigger selection, bounded TEXT and exact same-Workspace ResourceRef inputs from the pinned Routine revision, receipt identity validation, same-session exact retry, and Task detail navigation. Scheduled/provider trigger hosting, cursor/misfire settlement, and all build/test/OS/user acceptance remain open. Target also requires reviewed StandingResponsibility configuration grouping multiple Goal/Routine/Automation revisions, with no new scheduler; private ownership and Coworker status fence unattended Task admission. React/manual-trigger source is only an incremental proof and does not qualify scheduled provider-trigger hosting, sleep/wake or proactive monitoring. Competitor benchmark adds Test run and Run history as required responsibility/routine UX. Test is a real manual occurrence/Task and preserves ordinary Trust/approval; it never enables paused recurrence. Task-time source/connector repair remains separate from scheduler ownership.
stories.acceptance: Every occurrence ordinary Task; edit never resets logical cursor; current Coworker ACTIVE checked; local unavailable waits. A single chat-authored daily monitor + weekly report is reviewed and explicitly enabled with bounded source/action/budget and host readiness. Actual TriggerCoordinator dedup, no-change, missed-run policies, Task/Evidence verification, Pause new/Pause all semantics pass native daemon and OS tests; zero fake background availability. Owner can Test, Run now, Pause/Resume, Edit, inspect History, and delete/archive where supported. Duplicate events, sleep/wake, provider gap, and Test side effects are represented truthfully.
stories.negative_cases: DST gap/fold, restart catch-up, duplicate webhook, no-change poll, cursor race; Coworker head changes before selection recheck, exact Coworker revision missing/foreign, stale Automation version, explicit pin preserve/change/clear; ManualTrigger rejects DISABLED/stale/foreign-host definitions, invalid inputs and changed RequestId payload, with exact retry after mutable dependency changes; definition create/revise remain PAUSED and do not implicitly activate recurring triggers. OAuth expiry, copied/changed Skill, unqualified local app, source permission revoked, malformed event signature, duplicate webhook and concurrent host claims, asleep/offline local Runtime, unknown external Effect completion, startup outbox partial failure, missing source freshness, budget exhaustion.
stories.demo: Save a paused Automation with one ManualTrigger and an active pinned Routine, enter supported text inputs, create one READY Task, open it in Work, and confirm no Plan or agent execution starts and recurring status remains PAUSED. Simulate an ambiguous response and retry the exact RequestId to confirm the same receipt. Then edit the Coworker and verify the Automation pin remains unchanged; scheduled hosting across daemon restart remains a later system/user gate.

Verification remains open.

stories.title: MCP Apps/Skills and Discover
stories.implementation: Sandbox App frames/CSP/message bridge, MCP_SKILL manifest conformance, Discover status/grants/auth/install/version compatibility. Coworker Connect is optional during creation, available later through Settings or task-time repair. Unlimited CONFIGURED app/MCP/skill/local-capability catalog entries with paginated lazy discovery; shared authenticated installation is distinct from independent Coworker assignment and live Trust/CapabilityGrant, with no per-operation checkbox wall. Native unmediated tool restrictions must not be falsely claimed. Connection UX must support task-time Connect-and-resume, reuse of an already installed/authenticated connection, and progressive capability search/describe/execute instead of eager schema loading. Configured catalog count has no product ceiling; live activation remains bounded.
stories.acceptance: App cannot steal Operator credentials; exact-origin transport only; install metadata not authority; incompatible option disabled. Two Coworkers reuse one installed connection with separate assignment and revocation boundaries; secure provider OAuth can be cancelled; task-time Connect revalidates original Task; 100+ catalog items do not eagerly load tool schemas or spawn processes. A blocked Task can connect an eligible app securely, cancel without losing work, or reauthenticate; successful connection revalidates and resumes the original Task exactly once. Two Coworkers may reuse one installation/account with independent assignments.
stories.negative_cases: Forged app message, CORS escape, hostile manifest, missing package service. 10k catalog entries; OAuth cancel/timeout; changed MCP/Skill digest; reused account revoked for one Coworker only; task-time connection completes after Task cancellation; ambiguous external Effect before reconnect.

stories.title: Typed Presentation Runtime and reconnect-safe streaming
stories.implementation: Typed PresentationItem projection and isolated renderer registry with safe fallback; transient response deltas with per-turn/retry sequence; snapshot/cursor handshake, gap detection and resync; Context-used disclosure tied to exact authorized source revisions. Domain events remain truth and transient frames are not journaled as domain events.

stories.title: Adaptive Artifact Workbench and version history
stories.implementation: Partial: Artifact Workbench exposes a native Save As action for the exact selected managed ArtifactVersion up to 10 MiB. Its registered Tauri command checks expected Artifact/Workspace/version, ResourceRevision, digest, media type and size; the authenticated daemon content route verifies stored bytes and the native bridge checks response media/length before a same-directory staged write. Cancel does not read content; only Saved/Cancelled returns through WebView IPC. It also exposes an on-demand list of the latest 10 immutable versions through the existing authenticated exact-version read route, bounded text editing through the mounted append route, and a managed text/plain restore-as-new-version draft. Restore requires explicit confirmation and separate publication against a freshly loaded current head; stale conflicts preserve the draft. The append contract records user.text_edit but does not persist a distinct restored_from relation. An unconfirmed text-version publish locks the in-memory draft and original RequestId, disables edit/discard/close, and offers unchanged retry; it is not restart-persistent. Adjacent managed text versions can be opened by exact version metadata/content routes and compared side-by-side with the same bounded safe renderer; each pane labels its exact ResourceRevision. The comparison is read-only and does not identify changed lines or publish content. Recent history exposes exact output revision plus source-count/provider/Attempt provenance when recorded. Full qualified renderers, external/non-text restore, Library provenance, renderer sandboxing, and owner/system/code acceptance remain open. Current source has not been built or verified. Managed Markdown preview also supports a bounded safe subset (headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, fenced code, inline emphasis/code, confirmed HTTPS links) using React text nodes; unsupported or malformed syntax falls back to source text and no remote images load. This is not full CommonMark or an editor. Source remains unbuilt/unverified.
stories.acceptance: No immutable version is overwritten; conflicts are recoverable; restore appends a new ArtifactVersion; renderer failure preserves download/provenance; revoked sources are not represented as currently authorized context.
stories.negative_cases: Concurrent edits, stale compare input, restore racing a new version, linked/external or non-plain-text restore request, text over 1 MiB, missing historical blob, unchanged-content restore, incompatible renderer, hostile document, revoked source while open, dirty close/navigation; native Save As cancel without content fetch, selected-version/ResourceRevision/digest/media/size mismatch, external or >10 MiB content, daemon digest rejection, response media/length mismatch, temporary-write/rename failure preserving the destination, and no bytes/full path crossing WebView IPC.
stories.demo: Review a generated document/spreadsheet and coding diff; compare, save the exact selected version to a chosen path, edit, resolve a version conflict, restore a prior version as a new version, restart, and inspect provenance.

stories.title: Semantic-first RichPresentation and Host Guidance
stories.implementation: Commit semantic ConversationMessage and settle its turn without waiting for optional rich compilation. Add immutable RichPresentation publication/read paths, closed schema validation, bounded model intent, exact semantic/Artifact/Resource/source bindings, deterministic tool/result renderers, safe fallback, and Conversation-only negotiated HostSkill guidance. Keep host-bound system blocks sourced only from Core projections. Add bounded retry-fenced rich draft transport only after semantic streaming is stable. This story does not add arbitrary React plugins, side chats, cloud sync, or remote Runtime behavior.
stories.acceptance: Simple answers use no extra model call; complete semantic text is visible before any enhancement. Rich content is independently immutable/digest-bound and optional. Unsupported adapters still work. No model-generated status/approval/verification/download authority is rendered. Missing/invalid blobs, schema, renderer, or stream frames preserve semantic history. Exact ArtifactVersion deliverables and owner-requested deterministic ZIP work with digest-verified downloads. Rich UI passes accessibility, reduced-motion, responsive, and local-only desktop qualification.
stories.negative_cases: Hostile/invalid intent; forged host-bound block; cross-Workspace Resource/Artifact ref; message digest mismatch; missing/corrupt blob; unsupported renderer/version; stale retry frame; stream overflow/gap; direct media URL; unsafe Markdown/Mermaid/URL; bundle path traversal/duplicate path; missing source version; reduced-motion and high-zoom failures.
stories.demo: Run plain and rich Conversation requests with a qualified native Agent; disconnect during semantic and rich streaming; force compiler and blob failures; produce a Task report with exact Artifact cards and a reproducible ZIP; show semantic fallback, screen-reader/reduced-motion states, and direct-native comparison timing.
